title: Secret Invasion #1 Blank Sketch Variant Marvel 2008 Bendis Leinil Yu Skrulls
conditionDescription: Crease near the spine at upper left of front cover, light smudges on the white cover area, spots/stains on the back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Secret Invasion #1 (2008), Marvel Comics - Blank Sketch Variant Edition, ready for a sketch or signature. Written by Brian Michael Bendis, art by Leinil Francis Yu. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Condition: crease near the spine at the upper left of the front cover, light smudges in the white sketch area, and spots/stains on the white back cover (see photos). Interior intact.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
